about: Eight subjects are to get one sentence of study advice each. The splitter made only two parts of four subjects, two workers answered and a reducer merged them. All run on Cloudflare, free tier.
how: The splitter decides how many parts there are, so the number of workers is a result, not a setting.
learns: In map-reduce the splitter decides the shape of the work: two parts of four subjects run side by side, not eight parts.
watch: How many parts the splitter chose, and what that meant for the speed.
